about.title: What is Palworld
paragraphs: Palworld is a monster-taming open-world survival crafting game by Pocketpair. Capture creatures called Pals across the Palpagos Islands and put them to work, breeding, fighting and building. It launched in Steam Early Access on Jan 19, 2024 and hit full 1.0 release on Jul 10, 2026.

The 1.0 release opened the World Tree main-story finale (the eight-tower seal storyline), Pal awakening and mutation systems, 287 total Pals, and aquatic building. Cross-platform multiplayer is supported across PC / PS5 / Xbox / Mac, with 32-player dedicated servers.
